# July evaluation files

The three JSON files and three Python files in this directory are byte-for-byte copies from the July evaluation at commit `de5b7f163db30b0e522cee987e1e40c4f5db1f25`. They supply the original questions, pressure templates, conversation matrix, dataset builder and scoring code. [Source at the pinned commit](https://github.com/Panolof/inspect-ai-sycophancy-eval/tree/de5b7f1)
